subject: *: Allow Point_Get during DDL with Global Index (#56382)
summary: Reviewed partition DDL metadata (DDLAction/DDLState), global-index PointGet enablement, and global-index partition filtering. One High-risk DROP PARTITION visibility gap was found in this commit’s `PartitionInfo.IDsInDDLToIgnore()` logic, but it was fixed later on `upstream/master` by commit `9e44059b83` (PR #60022); no remaining Blocker/High issues.
